body_markdown:
**Allient Inc. to Showcase Latest Defense Technologies and Solutions at AUSA 2026**


[Download printer-friendly version](https://allient.com/d/?h=dadaa2d)


**Buffalo, N.Y. – 8 October, 2026 –** **** Allient Inc. (Nasdaq: ALNT) (“Allient” or the “Company”), a global designer and manufacturer of specialty Motion, Controls, Power and lightweighting composite / advanced materials products and solutions for targeted industries and applications, has today announced it will present its latest defense technologies and solutions at the Association of the United States Army (AUSA) Annual Meeting & Exposition, taking place October 12–14 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C.


Visit us at Booth #3439 or[get in touch](https://allient.com/contact-us/) to schedule a meeting during the event.


At AUSA 2026, Allient will showcase its technologies and solutions, including:


**UAS and C-UAS Solutions** – Allient will present UAS and C-UAS motors and drives, alongside UAS hangar, storage and deployment systems.


**Steering and Ground Vehicle Solutions** – The showcase will highlight electric power steering systems, steering actuators, rack-and-pinion systems, steering shafts and electric drive motor systems.


**Motion and Motor Technologies** – Allient will present frameless motors, mil-spec motors, linear motors, servo drives and controllers.


**Integrated Solutions and Advanced Materials** – Allient will also highlight integrated solution stacks bringing together its motor, drive, steering and control technologies, alongside composite structures, advanced material solutions and self-sealing fuel systems.


Live demonstrations at the booth will include a gimbal, electric power steering simulator, UAS hangar storage system and UAS propulsion system.


Allient will also launch a new initiative at the event, designed to showcase its defense technologies in a unique way.


“We’re excited to return to AUSA this year and showcase our advanced defense technologies and solutions,” said Steve Warzala, President of Allient Defense. “With a range of products and live demonstrations on display, we’re looking forward to engaging with attendees throughout the show and highlighting how Allient is helping shape the future of defense.”


For more information and to schedule a meeting with us at the event, visit[here](https://allient.com/ausa/) .


**ABOUT ALLIENT INC.**


Allient (Nasdaq: ALNT) is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction, and facility infrastructure. A family of globally responsible companies, Allient takes a One-Team approach to “Connect What Matters” and provides the most robust, reliable, and high-value products and systems by utilizing its core Motion, Controls, and Power technologies and platforms.


Headquartered in Buffalo, N.Y., Allient employs more than 2,500 team members around the world.
